content: The Kerala (Alteration of Name) Bill, 2026 and the National Co-operative Development Corporation (Amendment) Bill, 2026 were moved by Minister of State for Home Nityanand Rai and Minister of State for Cooperation Murlidhar Mohol

title: Applicant to Ram Temple CEO post calls for transparency in selection process
content: Eighteen people have been called for an interview in Ayodhya from a poll of 5,200 applicants; the shortlist of candidates and criteria for selection should be made public, the former IPS officer says

title: NCC cadets take out ‘Har Ghar Tiranga’ rally with 200-foot-long national flag
content: Cadets from various schools and colleges display tricolour flags and take out the rally chanting ‘Vande Mataram’ and ‘Har Ghar Tiranga’ slogans

title: Governor issues show-cause notice to Bangalore University Vice-Chancellor
content: The Governor seeks an explanation from Vice-Chancellor following a series of complaints on alleged irregularities that took place during his tenure as the Registrar (Evaluation) of Bangalore University

title: Hundreds rally against FCRA amendment in Aizawl
content: Council of Churches in Mizoram warn that the Bill could empower authorities to seize and sell the assets and properties of churches and NGOs whose FCRA registrations are cancelled or not renewed

content: Tributes pour in from across the political and intellectual spectrum as colleagues, friends and admirers remember the nuclear scientist, science communicator and public intellectual.

content: The session was aimed at encouraging students to think beyond conventional career options and develop a broader perspective on their future aspirations

title: M.P. Parameswaran, renowned nuclear scientist and Marxist theorist, dies at 92
content: Parameswaran was one of the earliest and foremost members of Kerala Sastra Sahithya Parishad. His ideas on the ‘fourth world’ had triggered wide debate and eventually led to his expulsion from CPI(M) in 2004

title: Kerala CPI(M) State secretary  accuses CMO of harbouring synthetic drug peddlers

content: Kerala Forest Research Institute finds no major cracks or deep slope failure but warns of loose rocks falling during rain; NHAI asked to begin stabilisation work

content: The findings of the audit are expected to help the civic body identify major sources of emissions and formulate targeted interventions to reduce its carbon footprint

title: Bidadi project: Farmers’ delegation from two villages meets Chief Minister, appeals to him to issue final notification
content: This comes a day after JD(S) Youth Wing president Nikhil Kumaraswamy concluded a two-day padayatra from Byramangala to Bengaluru opposing the project.

title: Gangs of WhatsAppur: Mumbai’s thieves reinvent codes for digital age
content: Mumbai police have made headlines by unearthing a pickpocketing ring that relied on encrypted WhatsApp chats for coordination. This gang demonstrated intricate organization, defining roles and modifying their communication codes daily. Historically, thieves adapted hand signals and glances to avoid capture, yet this contemporary approach shows how technology is reshaping criminal tactics, enabling faster and safer exchanges.

title: Trump's Turkey takeout: World's most protected man spirited out in catering container
content: In a covert operation to ensure President Trump's safety, his security team reportedly employed a catering vehicle to transport him from a decoy aircraft in Turkey, responding to credible Iranian threats. This complex plan involved a smaller airplane ferrying him to Britain while a decoy remained in view, highlighting the ongoing challenges of protecting a president using foreign-supplied aircraft.

title: Lionel Messi steps away from football after father's death, no return date yet
content: Jorge Messi, 68, died at a clinic in Rosario after a prolonged illness. He had been battling health issues this year and was unable to attend FIFA World Cup matches.

title: ‘Seaport’: Heavy rain leaves Jewar airport waterlogged, sparks online jibes
content: Heavy rain caused temporary waterlogging near Noida International Airport's terminal and parking area.  Online mockery followed visuals of rainwater collected in the parking zone and passage.  Airport authorities stated the waterlogging was temporary and cleared within thirty minutes.  The incident occurred less than two months after the airport's inauguration on March 28, 2026.  Flight operations and overall airport functioning remained unaffected by the brief water accumulation.

title: Aluminium foil & stainless steel are safe in an air fryer, but these materials aren't
content: Air fryers use circulating hot air, unlike microwaves, for cooking food. Certain materials like plastic and Styrofoam should never go inside the appliance. Oven-safe glass, ceramic, and stainless steel are generally safe for air fryer use. Aluminium foil and parchment paper can be used but require food to hold them down. Proper material selection ensures efficient cooking and prevents safety hazards.

title: Duan Jansen, Marco’s twin brother, earns maiden South Africa call-up for Namibia tour
content: Duan Jansen, twin brother of Marco, has received his maiden South Africa call-up for the Namibia tour. The Proteas will play a T20I tri-series against Namibia and Zimbabwe before a historic three-match ODI series against Namibia. Bjorn Fortuin will captain the squad, while several domestic performers have earned opportunities to strengthen South Africa’s international depth.

title: Fitch retains India’s credit rating at BBB-, sees strong economy
content: The ratings agency said the Indian economy continues to demonstrate resilience despite the energy shock arising from the conflict in West Asia, supported by a strong growth outlook and sound external financing fundamentals.

title: 'Gruesome assault': High court denies bail to Olympic medallist in murder case
content: Justice Purushaindra Kumar dismissed Kumar's bail plea on August 6, citing concerns about his ability to influence witnesses, his conduct before his arrest, the seriousness of the alleged offence and his ability to affect the outcome of the ongoing trial.

title: Mark Zuckerberg's $300M yacht booed over rescue call; clarification issued
content: Mark Zuckerberg's superyacht Launchpad faced criticism after a stranded boat incident. The vessel's crew was reportedly on a different radio channel during the emergency. Help was already en route when the yacht's crew reviewed the assistance request. The yacht, valued at $390 million, was closer to the distressed skiff. Passengers on a nearby cruise ship booed the yacht's perceived inaction.

title: Old allies, new equation? Why SAD and BJP may join hands for Punjab polls
content: Haryana chief minister Nayab Singh Saini has categorically denied any prospective alliance with Shiromani Akali Dal for 2027 Punjab assembly elections. However, recent discussions between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and SAD leader Sukhbir Singh Badal have led to renewed speculation around possible tie-up. After the meeting, SAD, whose electoral fortunes have waned significantly, changed its perspective on delimitation. The BJP is reportedly keen on dominating any potential alliance.

title: Yonkers uncovers buried river, creating 14,000 sq ft of aquatic habitat
content: In 2012, Yonkers, New York, completed a project to uncover a section of the Saw Mill River that had been buried beneath a downtown parking lot since the 1920s. The former Larkin Plaza was turned into a three-acre public park. Within six months, the restored river supported 14,000 square feet of new aquatic habitat and several species.

title: Utah boy, 13, spends 300 hours 3D-printing wheelchair for toddler
content: A 13-year-old boy from Lehi, Utah, spent about 300 hours during his summer designing, printing, testing and assembling a custom mobility chair for a 21-month-old girl. Zac Waters found MakeGood, a nonprofit that provides free 3D-printed mobility devices, and used his interest in 3D printing to build a chair tailored to the toddler’s needs.

title: Accenture CEO Julie Sweet makes an 'August request' to employees
content: Accenture has implemented a new policy allowing employees to carry over their unused vacation days, aiming to bolster business performance as the fiscal year winds down. CEO Julie Sweet has urged employees to maximize their efforts in these critical weeks. However, this adjustment may inadvertently dissuade workers from taking necessary breaks, raising concerns among investors following a decline in new bookings.

title: Retirement homes get regulatory push: What buyers and senior citizens should know
content: In light of new safety regulations introduced by the Centre, retirement homes are set to undergo heightened scrutiny. Each state and Union Territory will embrace these policies designed for senior living facilities. Key aspects of the guidelines include RERA registration and the establishment of senior-friendly infrastructures. Developers will be required to follow these updated rules, reinforcing the regulatory framework governing this burgeoning housing market.

title: Stefon Diggs earns major Dan Quinn praise after Commanders move
content: Dan Quinn says Stefon Diggs has already exceeded his expectations for football IQ only days into his Washington Commanders tenure. The veteran receiver is making explosive plays, getting open against man and zone coverage, and helping younger teammates before fully learning the playbook. Here is what Quinn and Jaylin Lane said about Diggs’ early impact in Washington’s camp Tuesday morning.

title: Caitlin Clark’s family support through records, criticism and pressure
content: Caitlin Clark's journey in basketball has been profoundly influenced by the steadfast support of her family. Her parents not only nurtured her love for the game but also equipped her with essential skills. They stood by her side through all moments of intense pressure and injury struggles. Their foundational presence has been crucial in building her confidence and propelling her career forward.

title: Tim Anderson retires after 10 MLB seasons, opens up on difficult final years
content: Tim Anderson is retiring after 10 MLB seasons at age 33. The former White Sox star won the 2019 AL batting title, made two All-Star teams and finished with 991 games, 98 home runs, 350 RBIs and 122 steals. Chicago will honor him Sept. 17 against Detroit. His career also included a Silver Slugger, a memorable Field of Dreams home run and a difficult final stretch.

title: Direct tax collections rise sharply to Rs 8.11 lakh crore; non-corporate taxes lead
content: India's direct tax collections have surged impressively, seeing an increase of over twenty-three percent. As of August 10, gross direct tax collections reached a staggering Rs 9.55 lakh crore. The bulk of these collections stemmed from non-corporate tax receipts, while both corporate tax collections and Securities Transaction Tax experienced notable year-on-year growth. Nevertheless, government-issued refunds only saw a slight uptick during this period.

title: Pune conversion case: UK-based OCI holder booked under new Maharashtra law
content: Pune Police registered an FIR against a UK OCI cardholder for alleged religious conversion attempts.  The accused allegedly spoke about Jesus and made statements about Hindu deities.  In a separate case, a 21-year-old man was arrested under the Maharashtra Freedom of Religion Act.  This development follows a wider debate over religious conversion and foreign funding.  Maharashtra CM Devendra Fadnavis stated that transparent organizations have nothing to fear.

title: Suriya reveals why his 1,700 sq ft Mumbai home feels better than Chennai bungalow
content: Actor Suriya enjoys the intimate charm of his 1700 sq ft home in Mumbai, a space filled with warmth and comfort. The couple moved here to reinforce family ties with Jyotika's parents during the pandemic. Their transition underscores the significance of family in challenging times. Don't miss Suriya's upcoming film 'Vishwanath and Sons,' releasing on August 14.

title: IPL cricketer Abishek Porel arrested on rape charge; woman alleges promise of marriage
content: Bengal Police arrested cricketer Abishek Porel on Tuesday in connection with a rape case.  The arrest followed a directive from the Calcutta High Court regarding the complaint.  A medical student alleged a physical relationship on the promise of marriage.  The complaint also includes charges of criminal intimidation and recording intimate moments.  Porel's career is now overshadowed by these ongoing legal proceedings.

title: UPI MDR: What is being proposed, and who pays the final cost? Explained
content: The government has clarified that UPI will continue to remain free for consumers and no transaction charges will be applicable to person-to-person payments. The government has also said that if an MDR is introduced in the future it will only be applicable to a limited category of merchant transactions.

title: Speeding BMW runs over woman in Delhi, villagers block road near T-3 terminal
content: A 48-year-old house help was killed by a speeding BMW car in Delhi. The driver, identified as Deepak, was apprehended by police officials after the incident. Angry locals blocked a road in protest, disrupting traffic movement near the airport. The victim's family expressed their desire for justice and strict action against the driver. Authorities have registered a case and initiated legal proceedings against the apprehended driver.

title: Born in Ronaldo's hometown, ex-Australia cricketer to lead Portugal's T20 WC bid
content: Henriques, who played four Tests, 16 ODIs and 24 T20Is for Australia, will lead Portugal's 14-member squad at the T20 World Cup Europe Sub-Regional Qualifier C in Finland.

title: Maya Angelou's quote on why people remember how you made them feel
content: Maya Angelou’s insights emphasize that emotions are powerful and influential. Our words and deeds leave a significant emotional mark on those we encounter. By practicing kindness and showing empathy, we cultivate meaningful relationships in our daily lives. Aiming to be considerate allows us to leave others with positive feelings, ultimately shaping our interactions and enriching our experiences.

title: 'Discontent answered with bullets': MEA slams Pakistan over PoK crackdown
content: India's external affairs ministry has strongly denounced Pakistan's actions concerning Pakistan-occupied Kashmir, where protests were met with brutality, leading to numerous fatalities. The Joint Awami Action Committee, prohibited from operating, led rallies demanding a fair distribution of refugee seats. Additionally, upcoming elections in the region were marred by violence and claims of electoral fraud, prompting India to call on the global community to hold Pakistan accountable for these violations.

title: US influencer faces action in Australia after picking up baby wombat for viral reel
content: A trending video captured influencer Sam Jones removing a baby wombat from its mother, sparking outrage and prompting Australian authorities to reconsider his visa. Wildlife professionals cautioned against the dangers of interacting with wild creatures for social media fame. This event underscores a crucial message about respecting Australia's native wildlife, urging travelers to admire wombats from a safe distance without direct contact.

title: 'Eetha' New Release Date: Shraddha and Laxman Utekar film moves to December 4
content: Shraddha Kapoor's highly anticipated biopic Eetha has shifted its release date. The film will now premiere on December 4, avoiding a box-office clash. This new date places Eetha against an upcoming comedy film. The movie is based on the life of Vithabai Narayangaonkar. Makers plan to launch the trailer from Narayangaon.

title: PM Modi, Shah, Sonia, Rahul attend reception of Supriya Sule’s daughter - pics
content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Amit Shah attended Revati Sule's wedding reception.  Rahul Gandhi and Sonia Gandhi were also present at the high-profile event.  Sharad Pawar hosted the reception for his daughter Supriya Sule's daughter.  Several Union ministers and opposition leaders joined the celebration.  The event brought together leaders from across the political spectrum.

title: Caitlin Clark turns childhood memory into 22,000-book impact for kids
content: Caitlin Clark's foundation collaborates with Scholastic to launch an impactful book donation initiative. This program aims to distribute 22,000 books to young readers in Iowa and Indiana, focusing on children from pre-K to eighth grade to enhance their reading abilities. Inspired by her own experience with Scholastic flyers, Clark is passionate about making literacy accessible and enriching the education of thousands of children.

title: Harbhajan Singh bowls ‘doosra’ after Punjab Police fact-checks video on drug crisis
content: BJP MP Harbhajan Singh responded after Punjab Police fact-checked a viral video he shared. He stated the drug issue cannot be dismissed by questioning video locations. Singh shared another video, questioning its origin and stressing Punjab's drug crisis. He criticized paid trolls for attempting to hide the significant drug problem. Singh urged the Punjab government to focus on making the state drug-free.

title: 'Arunachal an integral part, nothing can change that': MEA on China's 'objections'
content: The external affairs ministry firmly asserts the integral status of Arunachal Pradesh as part of India. This statement is a response to China's persistent efforts to impose Chinese names on various places in the state. A total of twenty-seven historically and strategically important locations have been officially identified on the Survey of India map. New Delhi categorically dismisses China's renaming initiatives as invalid.

title: 'Mirzapur: The Movie' trailer out: Gaddi war gets bigger
content: The gripping Mirzapur saga is set to transition from web series to cinema! A recently released trailer showcases fan-favorite characters and electrifying combat, as the struggle for the Gaddi intensifies across uncharted territories and introduces new faces. Featuring an all-star cast, Mirzapur: The Movie is destined to captivate audiences when it releases on September 4, 2026.

title: Russell Wilson’s father Harrison Wilson III and his lasting NFL influence
content: The impact of Harrison Wilson III, Russell Wilson’s father, on his life is profound. With a background as an Ivy League graduate and a wide receiver for the San Diego Chargers, Harrison instilled values of perseverance and ambition in his children. Post his impressive 14-season NFL career, Russell channels his dad’s influence into philanthropic work via the Why Not You Foundation, championing the pursuit of dreams.

title: How Travis Kelce’s kindness helped Laila Edwards make Olympic history
content: Travis Kelce's philanthropic spirit shines through as he starts by donating one hundred dollars to Laila Edwards' hockey tournament fund, later upping the ante with a generous ten thousand dollars for her Olympic travel. This heartfelt contribution allowed her family to celebrate her gold medal triumph, highlighting the Kelce brothers' true character and commitment to supporting young athletes on their monumental journeys.

title: ‘Game on’: Prakash Raj’s challenge after his name ‘deleted’ from Bengaluru voter list
content: Actor Prakash Raj's name was unexpectedly removed from the electoral roll in Bengaluru, prompting him to question the integrity of the revision process. Deeply rooted in the area, he is committed to taking steps to restore his voting rights. He firmly believes that denying the electorate their power won't hinder change, as citizens can express their will through the democratic process.

title: LeBron James and Savannah James suffer a major community loss ahead of 76ers season
content: LeBron James and his wife, Savannah James, were preparing for their new chapter with the Philadelphia 76ers but they have been faced with a brutal loss in their community.

content: The woman has been identified as Jaiwanti, a resident of East Mehram Nagar. She worked as a domestic help.

title: 'State Of Border Will Reflect State Of Ties': India Warns China On Arunachal

content: The health department also conducted raids at Indira Canteens across Bengaluru, with officials checking hygiene, cleanliness and food quality at kitchens supplying meals to the public.

title: Madhya Pradesh Uses Rs 30 Of Every Fresh Rs 100 Borrowed On Old Debt
content: Madhya Pradesh's internal debt stood at around Rs 83,718 crore in 2015-16. By 2024-25, it had risen to about Rs 3.33 lakh crore.

title: No Sensitive Data Sent To China: UK Defence Ministry On Navy Drone Scare
content: The Ministry of Defence (MoD) has insisted there is no evidence that sensitive information was accessed or sent abroad, according to a report by the BBC.

content: His death marks the end of a long and influential journey that straddled science, social activism, literature and Left politics.

title: Himanta Sarma Says Will Visit Alappuzha Temple After Kerala Villagers' Appeal
content: The exchange began after Nabaarun Barooah, an author and political commentator based in Guwahati, posted a video on X following his visit to the temple in Kerala.

content: The forms seek details including the religious or sectarian affiliation of the institution, ownership of the land on which it is located, sources of funding, including foreign funding, and information about foreign visitors or students.

title: AAP MLAs Protest With Rice Bags In Delhi Assembly To Flag 'Scam', BJP Replies
content: Meanwhile, Delhi Minister Parvesh Verma said AAP MLA Kuldeep Kumar took rice out of his pocket and threw it at members and officials.

title: Lebanon Becomes 1st Middle East Nation To Formally Abolish Death Penalty
content: The abolition came as part of a series of bills to be discussed in the current legislative session, including a general amnesty law that has been debated for years.

title: Custody Battle Behind Children's Murders In Bengaluru 5-Star Hotel: Police
content: SG Imran, 45, was found lying in a pool of blood in the hotel room's toilet with his neck slit. His daughters, aged 8 and 10, were found on the bed just metres away.

title: 'I Thank All Those Who Stood By Me': Gautam Adani After US Court Relief
content: Earlier, a court in the US dismissed all criminal charges against him and others in a case related to securities and wire fraud.

title: Who Was Khudiram Bose, One Of India's Youngest Freedom Fighters, Hanged At 18
content: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Tuesday paid tribute to freedom fighter Khudiram Bose on his martyrdom day.

title: Analysis: Five Reasons A BJP-Akali Reunion Will Not Be Easy
content: Both BJP and Akali Dal tested the waters by contesting 2022 assembly and 2024 Lok Sabha elections solo but the results made them realise that had they fought together, the vote percentage might have gone up.

title: Rajya Sabha Passes Bill To Set Up Panel To Appoint Chiefs, Members Of Tribunals
content: Replying to the debate on the Bill, Minister for Law and Justice Arjun Ram Meghwal said tribunals play a complementary role to ensure speedy justice.

content: Shiva Surya, a student of Ramavilasam Higher Secondary School at Chokli, has been missing since Saturday afternoon.
